title: Odyssey Simulates Autonomous Fly with 166,000 Neuron Brain Model
summary:
A biological neural map is now steering a virtual insect through environments generated by artificial intelligence. Odyssey integrated a real fruit fly brain connectome consisting of about 166,000 neurons into its Odyssey-3 world model, allowing a simulated fly to navigate 3D spaces without pre-built levels or human controllers.

The demonstration features a simulated organism that behaves autonomously within worlds imagined and generated by the AI. The project has since gained visibility on social media, drawing commentary from writers such as Neal Stephenson.
